title: DARTS: Differentiable Architecture Search
abstract: We address the scalability challenge of architecture search by proposing a differentiable architecture search method.

title: Efficient Neural Architecture Search via Parameter Sharing
authors: Hieu Pham;Melody Y. Guan;Barret Zoph;Quoc V. Le;Jeff Dean
abstract: Our approach to NAS achieves a 1000x speedup over state-of-the-art NAS methods.

title: Neural Architecture Search with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We use a recurrent network to generate the model descriptions of neural networks and train this RNN with reinforcement learning to maximize the expected accuracy.

title: Practical Bayesian Optimization of Machine Learning Algorithms
abstract: We describe a general framework for using Bayesian optimization for hyperparameter tuning.

title: Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Fast Adaptation of Deep Networks
abstract: We propose MAML an algorithm for meta-learning that is model-agnostic.

title: Siamese Neural Networks for One-shot Image Recognition
abstract: We describe a method for one-shot image recognition using siamese neural networks.

title: Zero-Shot Learning Through Cross-Modal Transfer
authors: Richard Socher;Milind Ganjoo;Christopher D. Manning;Andrew Y. Ng
abstract: We introduce a model that can recognize objects in images even if no training data is available for the class.
